description: United States Interagency Elevation Inventory is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Office for Coastal Management; USGS, United States Geological Survey. View a nationwide listing of known high-accuracy topographic and bathymetric data, with descriptive data and direct links or contact information to access each dataset. This catalog of publicly available, high-accuracy elevation data for the United States and its territories is collaboratively maintained by six federal partners. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Landslides. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
